Catalog.Name: Street
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 VP per adjacent building, counted once across your Streets.

Catalog.Name: House
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per Shop within 2 tiles (max 2; Shop capacity applies). Place: +1 VP per adjacent house.

Catalog.Name: Cottage
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin beside a Park or Lake. Place: +1 VP per adjacent park. No Links.

Catalog.Name: Shop
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per house within 2 tiles (max 3; house capacity applies), and +1 for a Farm within 3. Both owners earn a coin.

Catalog.Name: Farm
Catalog.Rules: Links to up to 3 Shops within 3 tiles. Each adjacent Farm pays both owners +1 coin.

Catalog.Name: Park
Catalog.Rules: Joins and scores the connected park.

Catalog.Name: Wild Garden
Catalog.Rules: A park tile of size 1. Can start or bridge parks.

Catalog.Name: Grant
Catalog.Rules: +4 coins now, then discard.

Catalog.Name: Avenue
Catalog.Rules: Road worth 2 tiles for Longest Road. Payout: +1 coin beside at least 2 buildings.

Catalog.Name: Roundabout
Catalog.Rules: Your Roundabout scores +1 VP whenever anyone places a building beside it.

Catalog.Name: Orchard
Catalog.Rules: A Farm that also counts as a park tile.

Catalog.Name: Lake
Catalog.Rules: Not a park; adjacent houses earn +1 coin and count it as a park neighbour.

Catalog.Name: Vineyard
Catalog.Rules: Pays nothing for 2 payouts, then +3 coins each payout.

Catalog.Name: Startup
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1, then +2, then +3 coins, remaining at +3.

Catalog.Name: Market
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per own Shop within 2 tiles (max 4).

Catalog.Name: Contractor
Catalog.Rules: +1 coin when you place a House or Shop, up to 2 per round.

Catalog.Name: Apartment
Catalog.Rules: Payout: Counts as 2 houses for nearby Shops. Place: +2 VP per adjacent Home building.

Catalog.Name: Cafe
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per adjacent house or shop (max 3). End: +2 VP beside a park.

Catalog.Name: Fountain
Catalog.Rules: A park tile of size 2.

Catalog.Name: Factory
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +2 coins. End: adjacent houses and cafes lose 1 VP, including yours.

Catalog.Name: Sapling
Catalog.Rules: Park size 1. After 2 payouts grows into a Forest of size 3 and scores the park.

Catalog.Name: Bank
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +2 coins. Stackable, max 3.

Catalog.Name: Town Hall
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +2 coins if you own at least 3 Civic-tagged buildings, including this.

Catalog.Name: Museum
Catalog.Rules: End: +1 VP per other Culture building you own (max 8).

Catalog.Name: Chamber of Commerce
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per 2 Trade buildings you own (max 4).

Catalog.Name: Warehouse
Catalog.Rules: Gain a Street at round start. The first Street you place each round pays +1 coin.

Catalog.Name: Builders' Yard
Catalog.Rules: Gain a Street or random Common of your choice at round start.

Catalog.Name: Hospital
Catalog.Rules: The nearest Hospital within 4 tiles of an emergency scores +1 VP.

Catalog.Name: Tourist Office
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per own Culture building (max 3).

Catalog.Name: Tax Office
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per 4 own houses.

Catalog.Name: Depot
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per 5 own road tiles (max 4).

Catalog.Name: School
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per own house within 2 tiles (max 4).

Catalog.Name: Granary
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per own Shop without a Farm Link.

Catalog.Name: Stadium
Catalog.Rules: Adjacent houses gain a coin and Cafes lose one each payout. End: +1 VP per adjacent house.

Catalog.Name: Airport
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +3 coins. End: each house within 2 loses 1 VP, capped at 3 per player across Airports.

Catalog.Name: Skyscraper
Catalog.Rules: Place beside at least 2 buildings. End: +1 VP per building within 2 tiles (max 6).

Catalog.Name: Industrial Estate
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per Industry building you own, including this (max 5).

Catalog.Name: Housing Authority
Catalog.Rules: End: +1 VP per 3 Home buildings you own, including this (max 6).

Catalog.Name: Eco Council
Catalog.Rules: End: +1 VP per 2 Nature buildings you own (max 8), minus 2 per Industry building (min 0).

Catalog.Name: Gardener's Guild
Catalog.Rules: +1 coin whenever you place a park tile.

Catalog.Name: Architect's Studio
Catalog.Rules: Your first building each round pays +2 coins if placed beside your own building.

Catalog.Name: Renovation
Catalog.Rules: Replace one of your non-road buildings with a different building card from your hand.

Catalog.Name: Ribbon Cutting
Catalog.Rules: +1 coin per building you placed this round (max 4).

Catalog.Name: Rush Hour
Catalog.Rules: Your Links pay +1 coin this payout (max 8).

Catalog.Name: Land Claim
Catalog.Rules: Reserve an empty tile against other players until next round.

Catalog.Name: Central Station
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per Link you receive (max 6).

Catalog.Name: Senate
Catalog.Rules: End: +2 VP per tag on at least 3 own buildings (max 12).

Catalog.Name: Monument
Catalog.Rules: End: +6 VP. No payout.
